title: HR Manager
jd:
**About the Company**
 Rainforest is a purpose-driven organisation based in Bristol, UK, dedicated to building sustainable products and fostering a workplace culture rooted in wellbeing, inclusivity, and environmental responsibility. As the company continues to scale, it remains committed to attracting and developing talented people who share its passion for making a positive impact on both its employees and the wider world.
**About the Role**
 Rainforest is seeking an experienced HR Manager with at least 8 years of experience to lead and develop our human resources function. Based in our Bristol office, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the employee experience, driving HR strategy, and ensuring the organisation continues to attract, retain, and develop top talent as we grow. This is a fantastic opportunity for a seasoned HR professional to make a lasting impact on company culture and operations.
**Key Responsibilities**
 Lead the design and delivery of HR strategies aligned with business objectives. Oversee recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations processes. Provide expert guidance to senior leadership on employment law, policy development, and organisational change. Manage compensation and benefits reviews to ensure competitiveness and fairness. Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. Mentor and develop a small HR team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Monitor HR metrics and produce reports to inform strategic decision-making.
**Requirements**
 A minimum of 8 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years in a managerial capacity. CIPD Level 5 or 7 qualification (or equivalent) preferred. Strong knowledge of UK employment law and best practice HR processes. Proven track record of managing complex employee relations cases and organisational change initiatives. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational delivery.
**Benefits**
 Salary of 50,000 to 80,000 GBP, dependent on experience. 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility around core hours. Private healthcare and pension scheme. Ongoing professional development and CIPD membership support. A collaborative, values-driven workplace culture focused on sustainability and employee wellbeing.
